findings.lookup: Security code (max 50, starts alphanumeric, remaining letters/digits/_@.-) and service ZIP (required, max 10); both trimmed before request. The client can accept query parameters, but local fixture secrets should remain out of URLs.
findings.payment_methods: Credit/debit and e-check branches; actual enabled methods, brands and eligibility fetched from backend. Shared American Express validation code is not proof GMG accepts it.
findings.billing_fields: First/last name, address, city, country, state and ZIP required; phone and email optional in base client form.
findings.amount: Client regex allows at most two decimals and form range 0 to 9999999999; backend rules unknown. Do not infer zero payments or that maximum are accepted.
findings.fees: Review receives fee and total from server. Official tenant policy supplies card 2.75% minimum $1.50 and free bank payment; exact backend rounding remains unverified.
findings.timeout: Client starts with 1500 seconds but replaces it with (uttimeout - 5) minutes when global config is present; actual GMG duration unverified.
findings.receipt: Client renders payment date, amount, fee, total, transaction ID and authorization code; backend settlement behavior unknown.

limits: Source inspected as text only; no original JavaScript executed during this extraction
No production form/API submission, private account, checkout screenshot or transaction observed
Client branches do not prove tenant backend behavior
Guest checkout runtime, private grader and Puppeteer journey still to implement
